newsitem.title: USA: Cross-examination of Lori Fortier begins in Denver.
newsitem.headline: Cross-examination of Lori Fortier begins in Denver.

text.p: The cross examination of key prosecution witness Lori Fortier began on Wednesday with a discussion of accused Oklahoma City bomber Timothy McVeigh's attitudes about the Waco siege.

Fortier said she did not share McVeigh's attitudes about Waco, the scene of a botched FBI raid on the Branch Davidian compound in 1993 where about 80 followers of cult leader David Koresh were killed.

On Tuesday, she testified that McVeigh carried out the bombing of the Alfred P. Murrah federal building in Oklahoma City two years ago in revenge for Waco because he blamed the government for the deaths.

In exchange for her testimony, the mother of two has received immunity from prosecution at the trial of McVeigh, who is accused of planning and carrying out the April 19, 1995, bombing that killed 168 people.

Fortier's husband, Michael Fortier, is an old army buddy of McVeigh's and has entered into a plea agreement, admitting he knew McVeigh had planned the bombing but did nothing to stop it. He is also expected to testify for the prosecution.
